verdict.rationale: An embedded AI assistant that answers reader questions with citations is a fair capability to ask of a docs-site generator, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only Algolia DocSearch keyword search and the ability to embed custom React or MDX components. Those are an adjacent search feature and developer building blocks, not a shipped AI Q&A assistant with citations, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an embedded AI assistant on my docs site answers reader questions with citations into my content
